question: Which among the following have the lowest sex-ratio as per 2011 Census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan** has the **lowest sex-ratio** among the given options as per the 2011 Census.
 
• The sex-ratio is defined as the **number of females per 1000 males** in the population.
 
• According to the 2011 Census, **Rajasthan** had a sex-ratio of **928 females per 1000 males**.
 
• In comparison, **Tamil Nadu had a sex-ratio of 996, Andhra Pradesh 993, and Madhya Pradesh 930**.
 
• The sex-ratio is an important demographic indicator that reflects the social condition of a region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years, with the last one being in 2011.
 
• The sex-ratio has been a focus of government policies aiming to improve gender balance.
 
• Initiatives like 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' have been introduced to address gender disparities in various states.
 
• Improving sex-ratio is crucial for achieving gender equality and ensuring balanced social development.
